name: subcontracts
notes: Beyond the spec's route list the module adds POST /subcontracts/certificates/:id/bill (BR-5, the accountant's step), PUT /subcontracts/certificates/:id, GET /subcontracts/work-orders/:id/certificates, GET /subcontracts/work-orders/:id/back-charges, GET /subcontracts/subcontractors/:id/statement, and the variation decision endpoints POST /subcontracts/variations/:id/approve|reject. Only one certificate of a work order is open at a time (so the previous cumulative is the latest certified one); an order becomes `completed` when its whole current contract is certified; closing an order before that needs a reason (the closing adjustment, BR-6) and the `subcontracts.order.close` permission. Certification is approved by the project manager role and the order by the owner (management role), both editable rules (H-09). The certificate becomes `billed` when its bill is posted; a bill cancelled before posting leaves it `certified` for a new bill.
